notebooks.execution_method: Executed all 38 code cells sequentially from an empty in-process IPython namespace with scripts/execute_notebook_inprocess.py. The final clean validation run completed in 12.8 seconds, downloaded checksum-tracked Norne inputs from a pinned OPM commit, retained all result-bearing outputs, stored fifteen PNG figures, ran the finite-volume reservoir forecast, completed four ES-MDA updates, passed ert lint, screened well and SURF flow assurance, ran three real NeqSim process and ISO 6976 cases, propagated downstream constraints through field life, and calculated a 60-realization NPV distribution with zero stored errors or stderr. The normal Colab path clones, resolves and source-builds current NeqSim master. Maven Central DNS was unavailable in the controlled validation environment, so the retained local evidence used the pinned NeqSim 3.17.0 release JAR while recording the resolved current-master source commit. Retained PNGs were losslessly optimized without changing dimensions or numerical data.

rendered_visual_validation.notes: All thirteen display equations use Colab-safe dollar delimiters and were audited for balanced delimiters and single LaTeX command backslashes. All fifteen retained figures were inspected at original resolution for labels, units, legends, contrast, scales, clipping, overlap and consistency with stored numerical tables. The final inspection includes the closed-loop workflow, published property distributions, reservoir maps and forecasts, prior/posterior FMU evidence, flow-assurance profiles and shutdown window, NeqSim process and ISO 6976 results, constraint feedback, field-life rates, NPV distribution and sensitivity screen.

known_limitations: Published Norne data anchor the workflow, but vertical upscaling, fluid composition, synthetic history, well and SURF geometry, operating assumptions and economics are educational; this is not an official Norne history match, reserves statement, certified flow-assurance study, facility design or investment basis.
The portable finite-volume model runs in every environment. The full OPM Flow Norne deck is downloaded and inspected but not executed because a native Flow binary is not guaranteed in Colab.

The homogeneous steady flow-assurance screens do not replace calibrated multiphase transient simulation, detailed terrain, compositional hydrate and wax models, laboratory data or specialist design tools.
The compact process does not include dehydration, dew-point control, produced-water treatment, detailed compressor maps, heat integration, reliability or a certified metering chain.
The retained validation outputs use pinned NeqSim 3.17.0 because Maven Central DNS was unavailable; normal Colab execution source-builds the recorded current NeqSim master path.
FMU means Fast Model Update, not an FMI Functional Mock-up Unit.
